messages.content:
You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (52.5 s) ===
[0.0-2.8] JULIANA (Alarmed, Protective): "It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her."
[2.8-5.0] SCREEN: Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.
[3.0-5.0] LADY ASHCROFT (Cruel): "Then you should have guarded it better."
[5.0-8.8] SCREEN: Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
[5.5-8.5] ACTION: Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.
[6.5-7.8] JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate): "Barbara, don't!"
[8.0-9.2] SOUND_FX: A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
[8.8-14.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing together on the cathedral steps. Clarissa clasps a gloved hand to her mouth in mock shock before bursting into gleeful laughter.
[10.0-13.5] CLARISSA (Gleeful, Mocking): "Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!"
[13.4-15.6] GERALD (Smug, Cruel): "Perhaps that is where it belongs."
[14.0-17.5] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana looking down at the ground, tears streaming down her pale cheeks.
[16.5-19.5] ACTION: Juliana drops to her knees onto the wet courtyard pavement, oblivious to the dirt soaking through her white bridal gown.
[17.5-20.0] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up of Juliana's trembling hand reaching toward the leather ledger resting in the puddle.
[20.0-23.5] SCREEN: Wide shot of Juliana kneeling on the damp ground as the tall Mysterious Bearded Man strides purposefully into frame toward her.
[21.5-25.5] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man bends his knees and kneels down beside Juliana, extending his scarred hand to retrieve the fallen ledger.
[25.5-27.0] SCREEN: Close-up of his large, weathered hands gently lifting the wet, embossed leather book from the ground.
[27.0-31.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as he holds out the retrieved ledger and places it into Juliana's trembling hands.
[28.8-30.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Gentle): "Here you go."
[31.0-36.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man looking warmly down at Juliana, his rugged face full of quiet sincerity.
[31.5-33.0] JULIANA (Choked, Weeping): "They destroyed it."
[33.5-36.4] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Calm, Grounded): "They dirtied it. That is not the same thing."
[36.5-42.0] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Juliana pressing the soiled book tightly against her chest, weeping softly.
[37.5-38.8] JULIANA (Broken): "It was my mother's."
[38.9-40.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Gentle, Protective): "Then keep it."
[39.5-42.0] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man reaches out with both hands, clasping his strong hands tenderly over hers and the book.
[40.4-42.0] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Comforting): "Let them keep everything else."
[42.0-47.5] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of Gerald standing high on the stone steps, grinning arrogantly as he points an accusatory finger down at them.
[42.5-43.8] GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant): "Look at you."
[44.0-47.5] GERALD (Scornful, Spiteful): "A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!"
[47.5-52.5] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot behind the Mysterious Bearded Man looking up toward Gerald on the stairs. Gerald's arrogant grin slowly wavers.
[49.0-51.8] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Lethally Cold): "Choose your next words carefully."
